description_en: Submits a personal income tax record screenshot for forgery detection and returns a task ID
description_zh: 提交个人所得税记录截图进行伪造检测，返回任务ID
name: CreateImageIncomeTaxDetectionTask

parameters.help_en: The URL of the income tax screenshot to detect. Only HTTP/HTTPS URLs are supported. The image size cannot exceed 10 MB. External images are not supported. Only URLs accessible from the Chinese mainland public network are supported
parameters.help_zh: 待检测个税截图的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议，图片大小不超过 10 MB。暂不支持外网图片，仅支持国内公网可访问的 URL
parameters.name: image_url
